meaning: Description field is required for creating an order
action: Fix order creation payload

meaning: Do Not Honor - Bank has declined the transaction without specific reason
action: Retry with different payment method or contact bank

meaning: Invalid Card Number - The card number entered is invalid
action: Ask customer to re-enter card details

meaning: Insufficient Funds - Customer's account has insufficient balance
action: Send payment link, suggest UPI/different card

meaning: Expired Card - The card has expired and cannot process payment
action: Ask customer to update card details or use alternate payment

meaning: Lost Card - Card has been reported as lost
action: Do not retry. Ask for alternate payment method

meaning: Stolen Card - Card has been reported as stolen
action: Do not retry. Block and report.

meaning: Transaction Not Permitted - Bank does not allow this type of transaction on this card
action: Suggest alternate payment method

meaning: Exceeds Withdrawal Amount Limit - Transaction exceeds daily limit
action: Suggest splitting payment or retry next day

meaning: Exceeds Withdrawal Frequency Limit - Too many transactions today
action: Schedule retry for tomorrow

meaning: Issuer or Switch Inoperative - Bank server is temporarily unavailable
action: Auto-retry after 2 hours

meaning: System Malfunction - Bank system error
action: Auto-retry after 30 minutes

meaning: Customer cancelled the payment on the bank page
action: Send WhatsApp/SMS with direct payment link

meaning: Customer did not complete payment within the timeout window
action: Send reminder with new payment link

meaning: HDFC Bank intermittent connectivity issue
action: Auto-retry after bank confirms resolution

meaning: ICICI Bank server timeout during OTP verification
action: Auto-retry or suggest UPI payment

meaning: SBI Bank scheduled maintenance window
action: Schedule retry after maintenance (usually 30 min)

meaning: Invalid UPI VPA (Virtual Payment Address)
action: Ask customer to verify UPI ID

meaning: UPI transaction timed out waiting for customer PIN
action: Send fresh payment link via WhatsApp

meaning: Auto-debit mandate has expired and needs renewal
action: Send new mandate creation link to customer

meaning: Customer has revoked the auto-debit mandate
action: Re-engage via WhatsApp, explain benefits, send new mandate link

meaning: 3D Secure authentication failed - incorrect OTP
action: Send WhatsApp with new payment link, suggest different card

meaning: Razorpay risk engine flagged the transaction
action: Manual review required, do not auto-retry

meaning: Razorpay internal server error
action: Auto-retry immediately
